plan.title: Draft Buy Template availability with vendor lock off

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Set the configuration whose effect on Buy Template is being tested.
Apply the additional configuration required by the test case.
Give the draft a known title so it can be found in Drafts.
Configure a template so the eRFX draft is valid enough to save.
Add the required line item to the draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule for the saved draft.
Complete the draft setup with a participant.
Save the eRFX event as an unpublished draft.
Confirm saving the draft did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to reopen the saved draft.
Confirm the created event appears as a draft before opening it.
Open the saved draft's create screen.
Assert that Buy Template is not offered on the saved eRFX draft when vendor addition locking is Off.
